sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent signed translation vector (dr, dc); for this qualified reverse-direction case it is [-1, 2].
sequential_dependency.step_a: Locate the unique color-1 and color-2 marker cells, then subtract their coordinates in the episode-selected order to compute a signed row/column displacement.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Create a fresh zero grid and, for every nonzero non-marker payload cell, add the computed signed vector to its coordinate and paint the same color at that destination.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The destination of every payload cell is undefined until the marker-derived signed vector is known; reversing that intermediate moves the entire payload to different coordinates.
